title: Art in America Magazine April 1988 Lissitzky, Bill Jensen,"Tristan and Isolde"
descriptionText:
Delve into the world of art and photography with the April 1988 edition of Art in America Magazine. This issue features compelling discussions, critiques, and illustrations that cater to enthusiasts and scholars alike. Highlighting a range of topics, it offers an insightful look into the artistic zeitgeist of the era.

Among the noteworthy articles, you'll find pieces on Lissitzky, Bill Jensen, and a comprehensive exploration of the opera "Tristan and Isolde." With its content presented in English and originating from the United States, this magazine is a valuable addition to any art lover's collection or a photographer's research library.
